The mission of the Dean of Students Office is to ENGAGE, DEVELOP, and RETAIN Temple University students. We provide holistic support, advocacy, and education, equipping students to succeed and thrive at Temple University. If you need access to any additional resources, please click the links:

- Cherry Pantry

- Student Technology Assistance Application

- Student Financial Services for basic needs resources 

- Disability Resources and Services

If you any questions or concerns, please email [click-for-email] or call the main phone (215) 204-7188.
